title: RFPTicketCreatedEvent
description: Flat JSON payload carried in the SSE 'data:' line for the 'rfp_ticket_created' event (docs/real-time-notification/trackflow-BRIEFING.es.md §2-§3).

ticket_id.description: Unique identifier of the RFP ticket (e.g., 'tkt_0225' or UUID).

rfp_id.description: Identifier of the associated RFP record (e.g., 'rfp_0071').

client_name.description: Name of the prospective client organization.

services_requested.description: List of TrackFlow logistics services requested in the RFP.

status.description: Initial ticket lifecycle status when entering the system ('analyzing').

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the ticket was registered.
